_comment: 1.8 Village Guide pages for the mailbox, daily visits, finds and weather (mail agent). Each page: id, title, icon (assets/icons), paragraphs, optional pictures (icon keys, item ids or villager ids). Shown in Book > Village Guide.

pages.title: Your mailbox
paragraphs: The blue mailbox stands by your farmhouse. When its red flag is up, a letter is waiting.
Tap the mailbox, or the Mail button at the side of the screen, to read your letters. Some letters carry a gift: tap Collect to add it to your farm.
Letters stay in your mailbox so you can read them again. Use Delete read letters to tidy up. Your letters are also in the Book, on the Letters page.

pages.title: Daily visits
paragraphs: Every day one villager walks over to your farm. They wait by your farmhouse with a red ! above their head, and send you a note in the morning.
Tap them to see what they would like, for example 3 eggs. Give it to them for coins, XP and 30 friendship points.
Busy? Tap Not now. They wait until the end of the day. If you are short of something, Ask friends can help.
Everyone takes a turn, so you meet all six villagers every week. On a villager's birthday, they come to see you.

pages.title: Daily finds
paragraphs: Every morning a few little things turn up on your farm: a seashell, wild petals or acorns. Look for a twinkle in the grass and tap to pick them up.
Finds make lovely gifts. Pip adores seashells and Juniper loves petals.
Now and then a villager drops something on your farm. Tap it and it goes straight back to them, with 20 friendship points as a thank-you.

pages.title: Weather
paragraphs: Each day is sunny, rainy or misty. The small icon next to your Charm shows today's weather. Tap it to see what it does.
Rain waters your fields: crops you plant on a rainy day grow 5% faster. Rare fish bite a little more often in the rain too.
It never rains three days in a row. The Calendar in your Book shows today's weather and tomorrow's.
